reason: Large, cross-cutting planner context refactor touching central planner interfaces and dozens of optimizer/rule files, plus executor and session plumbing. Separating `PlanContext` from `EvalContext`/`BuildContext` can easily introduce semantic regressions in plan building, optimization, cardinality/costing, plan cache, and runtime behavior, so this is central and risky enough for a blocker/high-focused deep review.
